title: What is ZexverAI?
content: ZexverAI is an AI project focused on providing users with an accessible and helpful AI experience.

title: Getting Started with ZexverAI
content: To get started with ZexverAI, visit the official ZexverAI platform and follow the instructions available there. If you need help, contact the support team through the official Discord server.

title: Plans and Pricing
content: Check the official ZexverAI platform or announcements for the current information about available plans, features, and usage limits.

title: ZexverAI Features
content: For accurate information about current ZexverAI features, consult the official documentation and announcements. Features may change as the project develops.

title: Troubleshooting Common Problems
content: If ZexverAI does not work as expected, describe the problem clearly, include any relevant error message, and contact the support team through the official Discord server.
aliases: How do I report an error?

title: Contacting Support
content: If you need assistance, visit the official ZexverAI Discord server and use the designated support channel.

title: Reporting a Problem
content: When reporting a problem, explain what happened, what you expected to happen, and how the issue can be reproduced. Include screenshots or error messages when relevant.
aliases: How do I report a problem?
How can I report a bug?

title: Privacy and Security
content: For information about data collection, storage, privacy, and security, consult the official ZexverAI privacy documentation. Do not share passwords, authentication tokens, or other secrets in support channels.
aliases: How do I protect my account?
